text:
jordan: hi everyone! first day questions. trying to get Console access: need staging-admin for feature flag experiments and prod-readonly so i can view audit logs for safe rollouts. my okta groups only show 'console-read'. who do i ping?

tessa: welcome aboard! for staging-admin open IT access -> 'Console (Staging) Admin'. for prod-readonly use 'Console (Prod) - ReadOnly'. i'll sponsor both. drop your okta email and employee id here.

jordan: thanks tessa. okta: jordan.k@redwood.dev. eid: 91234. filing now.

ryan: hey jordan, heads up: feature-flag-edit is a separate role, make sure it's selected on the staging request. also, if you need to inspect the audit trail there's a separate 'audit-log-view' permission for prod.

infra-bot: Request ACC-9032 created by jordan, requested roles: console-staging-admin, feature-flag-edit, console-prod-readonly, audit-log-view. Status: Pending manager approval.

tessa: approved.

infra-bot: ACC-9032 approved by tessa. Assigned to it-oncall. Note: group propagation may take 10-20 minutes.

jordan: got console-staging-admin group after ~12m, but feature flags tab still disabled.

ryan: try clearing session tokens or run `rbx auth refresh`. sometimes claim propagation needs a fresh JWT.

jordan: did that, still blocked.

infra-bot: ACC-9032 updated: added missing role 'feature-flag-edit' to request. IT will finish provisioning.

aria: security note: prod-readonly + audit-log-view are granted only after onboarding checklist is complete. please schedule the short <30m audit training with me (calendar link: internal). for now prod-readonly will be scoped to non-sensitive projects.

jordan: thanks - scheduled training for tomorrow. any temporary workaround to view audit entries for my staging tests?

ryan: you can query staging audit via API: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN\" \"https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/audit?limit=50\"` — use your staging session token. perms required: audit-log-view (staging).

jordan: infra-bot reported ACC-9032 completed. i refreshed and can now toggle staging flags and see audit entries in staging. prod-readonly still pending security training, makes sense.

tessa: perfect. one small note: never toggle prod flags for onboarding evals. Always use staging-only flags or a canary with <1% and monitoring.

jordan: got it, thanks everyone! will go through the training and reach out if anything pops up. :smile:
